jobs.title: Telehealth Physician (Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

Healthcare is broken. If you've worked in healthcare for any period of time, you know this. Solace connects people to healthcare advocates who solve the problems they face in accessing care, and the physician plays an important role in this.

As a Solace Physician, you will build strong relationships and facilitate an unparalleled advocacy experience for our patients. In this role, you will collaborate with healthcare advocates to help our patients achieve their health goals to foster exceptional outcomes. By contributing to the development of a new patient care program, you will ensure that Solace is well-equipped to optimally serve a vulnerable population.

What You’ll Do

  • Learn the Solace systems, tools, technology, partners, and expectations, while also providing your unique clinical expertise in every interaction.

  • Be able to identify and prioritize patients’ needs and maintain a streamlined care continuum.

  • Oversee patient care plans in partnership with healthcare advocates to holistically address social determinants of health, i.e. food resources, transportation access, and support at home.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Board certification in family medicine, internal medicine or other relevant speciality.

  • Strong clinical skills paired with excellent organizational skills. You can balance multiple tasks and work under pressure without sacrificing organization in your communications and documentation.

  • Superior communication skills, as listening and empathy are the foundation for every patient interaction at Solace.

  • You're equally comfortable working with elderly patients as you are with individuals undergoing Social Determinants of Health.

  • Pride in your technical savvy. You have the ability to quickly and fluently learn new systems and softwares.

  • Extreme bias toward action and execution. You care about forging the system that empowers better patient outcomes, and you’re not shy about sharing your feedback.

  • Embrace change and iteration. You understand that rapid changes to the business, strategy, organization, and priorities is par for the course.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll join a spectacularly talented team of fellow engineers—but you will also be expected to independently own your product workflow from initial design requirements through deployment. You will be expected to move aggressively, and you will commit code daily, but you’ll get that rush of seeing your work in the wild with live users on a regular basis as you build a revolutionary product from scratch.

You are an experienced engineer who can identify problems and architect the highest-quality solutions. You are curious and enjoy working on ambiguous problems where the solutions are not (yet) well-defined. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren’t afraid to make mistakes and learn from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze product requirements and produce high-quality, production-ready code while creating a best-in-class user experience.

  • Build and maintain new user-facing features with everything from database models to UI components.

  • Be autonomous. You’ll take full ownership of your work, and you take responsibility and accountability for every last detail, every step of the way.

  • Be a collaborator. You’ll work with other engineers and cross-functional partners in product and design to build a world-class product and lead new initiatives to improve our user experience.

  • Create services and APIs to drive existing and new features for web apps.

  • Maintain the health of our systems and codebase, refactor and make improvements, and keep our systems robust and resilient.

  • Write clear specs to ensure product/code quality for stress-free deployment.

  • Drive large releases to production on a continuous deployment cadence.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience working in a start-up environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience on both frontend and backend development.

  • Strong React fundamentals and a background working with Typescript/Node.

  • An intuitive understanding of what it takes to create delightful, consumer-oriented experiences.

  • Strong communication skills that help you influence product direction and help collaborative visions come to life.

  • Extreme bias toward action and execution. You get antsy if you’re not writing code, improving the codebase, and vigilantly enhancing the systems that represent the big-thinking work.

Our Tech Stack

  • Typescript across all our applications

  • NestJS API with TypeORM

  • Postgres

  • Redis

  • React

  • Custom UI library built on shadcn

  • Tailwind

  • GCP

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Trust & Integrity Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Manager to lead the function that protects the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll build and manage the team responsible for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to patients, advocates, or Solace's operations.

This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, advocate accountability, and operational risk. You'll own the strategy and standards for case review, oversee a team handling escalations and investigations, monitor for emerging patterns at a portfolio level, and ensure advocates are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to CX leadership, you'll work closely with QA, operations, CX, and senior internal stakeholders to build a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve and to scale that trust as Solace grows.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

  • Coach and manage a team of Trust & Integrity Specialists, setting clear expectations and learning paths

  • Establish and refine workflows, SLAs, and quality standards for complaint handling, investigations, and advocate oversight

  • Conduct case reviews and calibration sessions to ensure consistency and rigor across the team

  • Build a culture of empathy, precision, and accountability within the team

Patient Safety & Complaint Management

  • Own escalation paths for the most complex or high-severity patient safety concerns and adverse experience reports

  • Ensure the team investigates and resolves complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, with clear documentation standards

  • Define criteria for urgent intervention and coordinate cross-functional response for the highest-risk situations

  • Serve as final escalation point for patients or stakeholders when a case requires manager-level judgment

Advocate Oversight & SOP Compliance

  • Uphold the process by which advocate behavior, conduct, and quality concerns are reviewed

  • Partner with QA and team leads to adjudicate cases requiring formal performance review or corrective action

  • Own the integrity and confidentiality of investigation records and reporting

  • Drive continuous improvement of SOPs and ethical guidelines based on case learnings

Risk Strategy & Pattern Analysis

  • Build and own risk monitoring practices across patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals

  • Identify systemic risk patterns and lead root-cause analysis, translating findings into concrete mitigations

  • Own the risk reporting cadence to CX and cross-functional leadership, including prioritization of high-severity issues

  • Lead development of internal playbooks and response protocols for known and emerging risk scenarios

Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategy

  • Act as the primary point of contact and thought partner for operations, clinical, product, and legal/compliance stakeholders on trust and integrity matters

  • Partner with QA leadership to define how systemic quality issues are distinguished from individual trust and integrity incidents

  • Represent Trust & Integrity in policy and SOP development, ensuring risk considerations are built into how Solace scales

  • Contribute to org-wide risk and safety strategy as a subject matter expert

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience managing or leading a team in trust and safety, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, compliance, or a related field

  • A track record of building or scaling processes, SOPs, or playbooks in a high-stakes environment

  • A calm, methodical approach to high-stakes or sensitive situations, with strong judgment under ambiguity

  • Strong investigative instincts and the ability to coach others to develop the same

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings and recommendations to leadership

  • Deep familiarity with complaint management, incident review processes, or risk frameworks

  • Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly across functions, including with senior stakeholders

  • A deep commitment to patient welfare and a clear sense of what's at stake

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

This is a rare chance to learn product management from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Product Manager at Solace, you’ll help shape how millions of people experience healthcare while working side-by-side with designers, engineers, clinicians, and product leaders.

Your job is to help us make healthcare feel human again. You’ll research, organize, and test ideas, build new features, and help us launch faster. You don’t need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done.

This role is for the ambitious, the curious and those who don't shy away from feedback. If you’re the kind of person who sees a problem and can’t resist solving it, keep reading.

This is an in-person role for new college graduates in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week. Start date: July 2027.

What You’ll Do

  • Learn what great Product looks like directly from people doing it every day.

  • Bring bold ideas and (occasionally) watch them get destroyed in the name of better ones.

  • Rapidly produce and launch concepts while laughing in the face of potential failure.

  • Partner with engineers, designers, and clinicians to deliver meaningful improvements for patients and advocates.

  • Keep projects moving forward, make sure deadlines are hit, and translate chaos into constant clarity.

  • Test, document, and ship features that make Solace better every week.

  • Grow your craft: learn how to write specs, analyze data, talk to users, and make smart product decisions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • A bias toward action. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you thrive on timelines that would be unrealistic for most others. You want to build things and learn fast.

  • Curiosity for how systems work.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a refined palate for controlled chaos.

  • Unfettered creativity paired with confident communication. You can explain your thinking simply.

  • A sense of care. You take pride in the details.

  • Bonus: Experience working on projects, internships, or student teams where you had to organize, lead or ship something real.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

As the Performance Creative Manager at Solace, you'll build and lead the creative engine behind an eight-figure monthly paid media program.

This is a builder's role for someone who speaks both craft and performance fluently: you'll define the testing frameworks, develop the team, negotiate the brand guardrails, and create the systems that turn creative production into a compounding performance advantage.

What You'll Own

  • Build, hire, and mentor the performance creative organization — creative strategists, designers, video editors, and creative operations — embedded in channel pods alongside media buyers across Meta, TikTok/AppLovin, and YouTube.

  • Own creative-driven CPA improvement across all pods.

  • Define and run the creative testing framework: concept, variant, and iteration definitions; weekly production quotas per pod; hit-rate targets; and the kill/iterate/scale decision system.

  • Own the creative analytics foundation: naming conventions and tagging taxonomy that make winning patterns searchable, measurable, and repeatable across channels.

  • Stand up and govern the content library — raw UGC and branded shoot footage, finished-asset archive with performance data, and the approved-claims and copy library — as the infrastructure layer for pod velocity.

  • Own the shoot roadmap and external creator/contractor budget: quarterly branded production planning, the UGC creator program, and the production partner ecosystem.

  • Negotiate and own the brand guardrails system — codified rules that let pods ship at velocity inside clear boundaries, with defined review lanes for net-new territory.

  • Own regulatory and legal compliance systems for creative: the approved-claims library and review-lane process, built with legal, appropriate to a healthcare environment.

  • Run the cross-pod creative review cadence so learnings transfer between channels — a winning Meta hook becomes a TikTok hypothesis becomes a CTV script.

What Success Looks Like

A creative organization that ships winning ads on a weekly cadence — on brand, compliant, channel-native, and relentlessly tested — where creative is the growth lever: rising hit rates, falling CPAs, and a library of compounding creative intelligence.

Who You Are

  • A builder who has stood up teams, systems, and processes from scratch — and knows the difference between an org chart and an operating system.

  • A leader fluent in both creative craft and performance data; you can give an editor frame-level feedback and defend a testing budget in the same meeting.

  • A systems thinker who believes velocity comes from infrastructure — taxonomies, libraries, briefs, and cadences — not heroics.

  • Excited to contribute hands-on in a high-growth, mission-driven startup.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Direct experience managing creative on $50M+/year in paid media spend.

  • Proven track record building and managing creative teams (strategists, designers, editors) of 5+ people, ideally in a pod or embedded model.

  • Deep fluency in creative testing at scale: concept/variant frameworks, hit-rate measurement, creative fatigue diagnosis, and iteration systems on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Experience running UGC creator programs and branded production — briefing, shoot planning, usage rights, and turning raw footage into high-velocity variant production.

  • Strong command of creative analytics: tagging taxonomies, creative reporting, and connecting asset-level data to CPA outcomes.

  • Experience partnering with brand and legal teams to build guardrails and claims-review systems that protect the brand without killing velocity.

  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • A bias for action — you move fast, make sound decisions, and thrive under tight timelines.

  • Bonus: experience in healthcare or other regulated industries, a marketplace business, or a fast-paced startup environment.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.

  • Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.

  • Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.

  • Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.

  • Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.

  • Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.

What You Bring

  • Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).

  • Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code.

  • Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).

  • Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.

  • Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields.

  • Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis.

  • Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.

Bonus Points

  • Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production.

  • Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.

  • NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.

  • Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.

  • dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.
